map.截面惯性矩计算（工程） 使用指南: Section Moment of Inertia (Engineering) User Guide
map.截面惯性矩计算器。输入常见截面（矩形、圆、工字等）尺寸，计算对中性轴的惯性矩 I: Section Moment of Inertia Calculator. Enter the dimensions of common sections (rectangle, circle, I-beam and so on) to compute the second moment of area I about the neutral axis, the section stiffness parameter used in beam bending and column stability analysis.
map.填写「矩形高 h / 圆径 D (mm)」。: Enter the rectangle height h / circle diameter D (mm).
map.矩形截面 I=bh³/12，计算梁抗弯刚度 EI 用于挠度公式。: For a rectangular section I = bh³/12, which gives the beam bending stiffness EI for the deflection formula.
map.组合截面（T 型、箱型）用平行轴定理求整体惯性矩。: A composite section (T-shape, box section) uses the parallel axis theorem to get the overall moment of inertia.
map.圆截面 I=πd⁴/64，校核轴抗弯。: For a circular section I = πd⁴/64; check bending about the axis.
map.矩形截面双轴惯性矩: Second moment of area about both axes of a rectangular section
map.：矩形 b=50 mm、h=120 mm 对强轴 I=bh³/12=50×120: For a rectangle b = 50 mm, h = 120 mm: about the strong axis I = bh³/12 = 50×120³/12 = 7.2×10⁶ mm⁴; about the weak axis I = hb³/12 = 120×50³/12 = 1.25×10⁶ mm⁴.
map.圆轴扭转剪应力计算（工程）: Round Shaft Torsional Shear Stress Calculator (Engineering)
map.强轴弱轴是什么？: What are the strong and weak axes?
map.惯性矩较大的轴为强轴（抗弯强），较小的为弱轴；型钢应使强轴对应大弯矩方向。: The axis with the larger moment of inertia is the strong axis (better in bending) and the smaller one is the weak axis; in steel sections the strong axis should face the larger bending moment.
map.平行轴定理何时用？: When do I use the parallel axis theorem?
map.求对非形心轴的惯性矩时，I=Ic+A·d²，d 为两轴间距；组合截面先求各分块对: For an axis that does not pass through the centroid, I = Ic + A·d², where d is the distance between the two axes. For a composite section, first find the Ic of each part about its own centroid, then shift and sum them.
